channel.title: Uniq — News
channel.description: Foundation news and the stories of people going through recovery.

item.title: Summer 2026 camps: 214 children, 96 parents, eight rotations in the Carpathians
item.description: The rehabilitation camp season has closed. Participants' scores at intake and six weeks after the rotation are set out here.

item.title: “I thought I was just tired”: Natalia's story, published with her consent
item.description: A programme participant describes the eighteen months between moving and first asking for help. The name is changed and the text was agreed with its author.

item.title: The mobile team started visiting front-line communities in Kharkiv oblast
item.description: Together with the NGO Dzherelo Nadii the foundation began regular visits by two specialists to eight communities with no psychologist within reach.

item.title: Annual report 2025: 6,840 people, 14,250 hours of work, an unqualified audit opinion
item.description: The foundation published its annual and financial reports for 2025 together with the independent auditor's opinion.

item.title: All staff and contractors completed PSEA and safeguarding training
item.description: Twenty-one staff and nineteen engaged contractors completed the mandatory training; the PSEA and safeguarding policies were updated.

item.title: Ostbrücke Stiftung backed the veterans stream for two years
item.description: A 24-month grant lets the foundation run peer support groups for service members and their families in four cities and deliver six residential programmes.

item.title: 10 October: what we say at open meetings, and why exactly that
item.description: For World Mental Health Day the foundation held seven open meetings in communities across Lviv and Zakarpattia oblasts.

item.title: The Lviv mental health centre received its first clients
item.description: On 18 March the foundation opened a permanent centre on Lychakivska Street: four rooms for individual work, a group room and a children's space.

item.title: Online support: the first line went live for five oblasts
item.description: The foundation launched online consultations for communities with no psychologist within reach — initially five oblasts, with a waiting time of up to five days.
